#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->

#### Potential Solution
<!--- Optional. Describe any potential solutions and/or thoughts as to what may be causing the difference between expected and actual behavior. -->

review_comments:
For future design consideration, this would have been better without the external dependencies. This causes rate limits when applied massively in parallel. 

The pattern for this problem in LEAN is the `HashSet<string> KnownSymbolStrings = new HashSet<string>`. The pattern isn't perfect, but it also doesn't fail if you run it 100x =)

The dictionary is missing `Market.GDAX`, wondering if the mapping is straight, based on the `ConvertCoinApiCurrencyToLeanCurrency` implementation? Maybe we could add some unit test for `Market.GDAX` too.
Or if it is yet to be implemented, we can throw some error?
The GDAX entry is not present in the dictionary because there is no mapping required for currencies (base and quote currency symbols for CoinAPI and GDAX are the same)
